purpose: Machine-readable KY GIS layer catalog for an ArcGIS-Pro-style mapping-rep tool hosted as a hidden page on BDW-Coils.
hosting_note: Prefer live REST for agency truth; use KPC curated GeoJSON for fast KY overlays that match Park Commander.
padus_note: PAD-US is a national snapshot. Kentucky live GIS (KYL) is preferred for KY state land when they disagree. Blackford Oaks WMA was live on KDFWR but missing from PAD at discovery time (maprep.js comment Oct 24).
parcel_note: Parcel data is approximate. Only Webster County parcels are on the state server. Per-county PVA viewer links: https://kentuckyportableclub.github.io/KPC-Links/data/ky-pva.json . Never scrape private owner names into a public page. NEVER use services.arcgis.com/33TOOklri9xpic7U (Grant County NM).

layers.title: USGS PAD-US Fee (national public land)
layers.what: National Protected Areas Database Fee layer. Primary national source in Mapping Rep. PAD-US is a periodic snapshot — KY live layers catch parks PAD missed (e.g. Blackford Oaks WMA).
layers.credit: USGS PAD-US
layers.licence_note: USGS public data. About: https://www.usgs.gov/programs/gap-analysis-project/science/pad-us-data-overview . Firewall tip from maprep.js: avoid UPPER()/OR/IN/second LIKE in WHERE; send a User-Agent (bare urllib can 403).
